_comment: One entry per inbox to poll. 'provider' is "gmail" (the default when absent) or "outlook". 'refreshTokenEnv' names the GitHub Actions secret holding that account's OAuth refresh token — generate with `npm run get-refresh-token` for Gmail or `npm run get-outlook-token` for Outlook. Add or remove accounts here; no code changes needed. dhibinvikash@outlook.com is deliberately absent: it forwards into dhibinvikash1@gmail.com, so polling it directly would only re-read the same mail. Listing an account whose secrets are unset is worse than omitting it — it is skipped with a warning nobody reads, while the dashboard implies a coverage it does not have. That is how seven backfill months reported success without ever opening that mailbox.
